comments.author: @marie-f1p5q
comments.text: Lord God, help us do the things that glorify Your name. Help us build Your Kingdom here on earth. Provide us with everything we need so that we can be a blessing to others.

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, your love knows no bounds and you give without measure. All that we have comes from you. May we give freely and generously in gratitude for all that you have given to us. Take our lives and all that we possess - our gifts, talents, time and resources - and use them as you see fit for your glory. Amen. Be patient, then, my brothers, until the Lord comes. See how patient a farmer is as he waits for his land to produce precious crops. He waits patiently for the autumn and spring rains. James 5:7, TEV

Lord Jesus Christ, hear our prayer and reveal your hand in our days. May those things be done that bring your future nearer and that let the world see you as the Savior who can lead us to our Father. Bless your Word within us. May our hearts be strengthened, and may we always live in your presence. We draw our life from your Word, from your promise, and we set our hope on you, our Lord and Savior. Show your might, Lord Jesus, and carry out the will of God over all the world, so that we may rejoice when we see God's glory appear and his will being done on earth as in heaven. Amen.
